scope_items.item: config.py: optional secrets_dir from WASABI_MCP_SECRETS_DIR (unset/empty -> None, ~ expanded, absolute)
_secrets.prepare: create dir 0700, refuse group/world-accessible with chmod 700 hint, refuse non-writable or non-directory, before the Wasabi call
_secrets.write: O_CREAT|O_EXCL 0600 file with token_hex name, JSON, fsync; failure names the created resource
iam_access_key_create writes secret to file, returns key ID, user, status, create date, secrets_file
iam_login_profile_create writes password to file, returns user, create date, reset flag, secrets_file
iam_mfa_virtual_device_create writes Base32 seed and base64 QR PNG to one JSON file, returns only serial and path
sts_assume_role / sts_session_token write credentials to file, return key ID, expiry, assumed role user, path
wacm_sub_account_create writes keys to file, returns scrubbed sub_account, access key ID, path
AC: with dir set, each tool writes a new 0600 file holding the secret (MFA: seed + PNG)

edge_cases.description: Secret write fails after the Wasabi call (e.g. name collision, dir removed): error names the created resource, no secret in the message, partial file removed
Pre-existing file or symlink at the target path is never overwritten (O_EXCL)
Secrets path exists but is a regular file
WACM response without keys in secrets-dir mode writes no file and returns secrets_file None
Relative and ~ paths resolved to absolute at settings load; empty value treated as unset
Directory permissions change between prepare() and write() (TOCTOU) are not rechecked; files are still 0600 so exposure is limited
